cookie.label: Login Cookie
cookie.description: The full 'cookie' request header from a logged-in music.youtube.com session. Open DevTools → Network, pick any request to music.youtube.com and copy its cookie header.

visitor_data.label: Visitor Data (optional)
visitor_data.description: Optional override for X-Goog-Visitor-Id. Leave empty to auto-detect from the home page.

manifest.description: Experimental YouTube Music provider that drives the real InnerTube API directly (no ytmusicapi / yt-dlp / deno). Streams premium 256k audio (itag 141) by solving the WEB_REMIX player cipher natively in Node.
